Card Q&A.a: 1 purple Digimon card or 1 purple Option card.
Card Q&A.q: What cards are returned to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 memory or less, set your memory to 3.
[On Play] Return 1 purple Digimon card or purple Option card from your trash to your hand.
Inherited Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
